description: Interactive changelog/timeline component: relative dates, an order select, a version filter and a recently-updated-pages feed

attributes.name: versions
attributes.description: Add a version filter select. Options come from each entry's data-version, own .version-tag text, or a v2-1-0 style id.

attributes.name: updates-src
attributes.description: URL of a JSON array of { title, href | url, modified | date } rendered as a recently-updated-pages feed. Only http(s) and relative links are kept.

attributes.name: data-label-controls
attributes.description: Accessible name of the injected controls nav.

attributes.name: data-label-order
attributes.description: Visible label of the order select

attributes.name: data-label-newest
attributes.description: Order option for the authored order (taken to be newest first)

attributes.name: data-label-oldest
attributes.description: Order option for the reversed order

attributes.name: data-label-version
attributes.description: Visible label of the version select

attributes.name: data-label-filter
attributes.description: Accessible name of the version select.

attributes.name: data-label-all
attributes.description: Text of the select's show-everything option.

attributes.name: data-label-status
attributes.description: Polite live-region text after filtering; {count}, {total} and {version} are replaced.

attributes.name: data-label-status-all
attributes.description: Live-region text when the filter is cleared; {total} is replaced.

childAttributes.name: data-version
childAttributes.description: Explicit version of an entry or release for the filter (wins over .version-tag text and the id convention).

structure.description: One container: its li/article/section children are the entries. One per release: the host's top-level children holding them are the releases.
